source.incident: A completed task could not checkpoint its workspace. Three registered approval runs finished, but their watches stayed unpolled because the task had not entered its wait.
source.identity: Tenant names, runner identities, record refs and native turn identities are pseudonyms. The recorded result, error and approval decision retain the observed behavior.

review.reason: Pause scheduled Cassandra backup retention on all three nodes to protect existing complete backups during recovery. This does not stop a currently running purge and must be followed by checking the purge service.
review.expected: The three retention timers are stopped, while Cassandra and existing backup objects remain untouched.
review.evidence: data-node-1 backup remains active since October20; the prior catalog showed the last complete cluster backup on October19.
